types.claim_limit: No vendor nominal TOPS denominator is frozen for int4; report measured GOPS only.

b_layouts.conversion_timing: rknn_B_normal_layout_to_native_layout wall time, reported separately and excluded from run_only_us

measurement_protocol.layout_pairing: For each shape/type/core mask, normal and native B-layout cells are adjacent; conversion time is never included in run_only_us.

correctness.preflight: Three deterministic randomized seeds for every type/core/layout axis on M=4,K=64,N=64; integer paths exact, fp16-to-fp32 atol=1e-3 and rtol=1e-5.
correctness.formal_cells: Constant-input analytic oracle; full output scan through 1,048,576 elements, otherwise 4,096 deterministic samples including both edges.

measurement_protocol.unstable_cell_rule: If run-only IQR/p50 exceeds 0.30, rerun that cell once. If the retry also exceeds 0.30, retain both attempts and terminally discard unless telemetry supplies a throttle explanation.
measurement_protocol.replication_note: Owner explicitly waived the same-day second segment; do not claim replicated-matrix evidence.

telemetry.missing_window_rule: A scheduled cell lacking both phase-tagged telemetry streams is invalid.

m_sweep.claim_limit: Synthetic M values are used only to locate the primitive-level turnover and never enter formal census-weighted scores; M=1 reuses the formal down-projection lineage.

failure_policy.boundary_probe: API create/allocation/run rejection is a valid N/A boundary result when captured with the exact stage/return code.
failure_policy.iova_guard: On any failed multi-core create/run, capture dmesg; if IOVA or dma-map keywords occur, stop that cell immediately, retain evidence, and do not modify the driver, kernel, DT, or runtime.
failure_policy.implementation_faults: Harness, packing, layout, and orchestration faults must be diagnosed and fixed; they are not grounds for silently dropping an axis.

claim_limits: rknn_matmul_run is an isolated primitive benchmark and does not load an RKLLM model.
Multi-core primitive measurements do not reopen or alter the frozen multi-core LLM deployment boundary.
Only int8 has the frozen 2 TOPS/core nominal denominator; int4/fp16 measured GOPS are not divided by an invented peak.
All OPE0 memory-relative scores inherit its single-segment owner-waiver evidence level.
